name: player_check_mission_weapon_availability
description: Player::CheckMissionWeaponAvailability writes whether a weapon-spec slot is available for the current mission, using authored single-player mission thresholds or the network whitelist table.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Player weapon-bank setup source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43ca90 validates the fastcall shape with ECX ignored, EDX as missionThreshold, stack arguments for packedWeaponSlotId and availableOut, the single-player rule missionThreshold != 0 && missionThreshold <= currentMissionId, and the network scan of four packed slot ids in the current mission row.

The native smoke verifies single-player unlocked, threshold-locked, and zero-threshold cases plus network mission 8 LASER_SABRE availability, mission 8 NAPALM rejection, mission 11 MISSILE availability, and earlier-mission rejection.
